form.label: AD Replication & Sync Health
form.description: State of Active Directory replication between domain controllers: per-link status (last success, lag, consecutive failures) from the scripted input, replication-related Directory Service and DFSR events (KCC, lingering objects, tombstone lifetime, DNS failures, USN rollback), sync start/end audit events, and Kerberos clock-skew failures.

search.query: `adx_repl_data` | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(consecutive_failures) as consecutive_failures, latest(last_result) as last_result, latest(last_result_text) as last_result_text, latest(last_success_epoch) as last_success_epoch, latest(last_attempt_epoch) as last_attempt_epoch, latest(transport) as transport by source_dc partner partition | eval lag_min=round((now()-last_success_epoch)/60,0) | where consecutive_failures>0 | stats count

`adx_repl_data` | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(consecutive_failures) as consecutive_failures, latest(last_result) as last_result, latest(last_result_text) as last_result_text, latest(last_success_epoch) as last_success_epoch, latest(last_attempt_epoch) as last_attempt_epoch, latest(transport) as transport by source_dc partner partition | eval lag_min=round((now()-last_success_epoch)/60,0) | stats max(lag_min)

panel.title: Critical events (lingering objects, tombstone, USN rollback)

search.query: `adx_repl_data` | stats max(_time) as t | eval m=round((now()-t)/60,0) | fields m

html.p: source_dc = DC that holds the inbound link, partner = replication source. Data comes from the scripted input in deploy_to_domain_controllers/TA_adx_replication (Get-ADReplicationPartnerMetadata). A stale "Minutes since last status collected" tile means the script is not running.

search.query: `adx_repl_data` | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(consecutive_failures) as consecutive_failures, latest(last_result) as last_result, latest(last_result_text) as last_result_text, latest(last_success_epoch) as last_success_epoch, latest(last_attempt_epoch) as last_attempt_epoch, latest(transport) as transport by source_dc partner partition | eval lag_min=round((now()-last_success_epoch)/60,0) | eval last_success=strftime(last_success_epoch,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), status=case(consecutive_failures>0,"FAILING", lag_min>240,"LATE", true(),"OK") | sort - consecutive_failures, - lag_min | table source_dc partner partition transport status last_success lag_min consecutive_failures last_result last_result_text

`adx_ds_events` EventCode IN (1308,1311,1388,1566,1865,1925,1988,2042,2087,2088,2095,2213,4012) | rename EventCode as event_id | lookup adx_replication_events event_id OUTPUT description severity | eval dc=coalesce(Computer, ComputerName, host), message=substr(coalesce(Message, _raw),1,300) | sort - _time | table _time dc event_id severity description message

panel.title: Replication errors by DC and event

search.query: `adx_ds_events` EventCode IN (1308,1311,1388,1566,1865,1925,1988,2042,2087,2088,2095,2213,4012) | rename EventCode as event_id | lookup adx_replication_events event_id OUTPUT description | eval dc=coalesce(Computer, ComputerName, host) | stats count, latest(_time) as last by dc event_id description | eval last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - count

html.p: Requires the audit policy "Audit Detailed Directory Service Replication" (Security events 4932/4933).

search.query: `adx_security_events` (EventCode=4932 OR EventCode=4933) | eval dc=coalesce(Computer, ComputerName, host), status_code=coalesce(Status_Code, StatusCode, Status), naming_context=coalesce(Naming_Context, NamingContext), source_dra=coalesce(Source_DRA, SourceDRA) | stats count, sum(eval(if(EventCode=4933 AND status_code!="0",1,0))) as failed_syncs by dc naming_context | sort - failed_syncs

panel.title: Kerberos clock-skew failures (event 4771, code 0x25) - time sync

html.p: Clients whose clock drifts more than 5 minutes from the DC: a typical side effect of broken AD time synchronisation.

search.query: `adx_security_events` EventCode=4771 (Failure_Code=0x25 OR Result_Code=0x25) | eval client=coalesce(IpAddress, Client_Address, src_ip), user=coalesce(TargetUserName, Account_Name) | stats count, latest(_time) as last by client user | eval last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - count
